mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, which may increase armodafinil plasma concentrations; armodafinil induces CYP3A4, potentially reducing clotrimazole efficacy.
action: Monitor for armodafinil side effects (insomnia, headache, tachycardia); consider clotrimazole efficacy monitoring; dose adjustment may be needed if interaction becomes clinically significant.
